classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Design up to two compact protein binders against a user-supplied target structure, evaluate binding affinity and sequence quality for each candidate, and return a ranked candidate list.
assumptions: Two bindcraft shards (seed=1, seed=2), each requesting num_designs=1 with filter_mode=permissive, balance trajectory success rate against minimal GPU runtime; max_parallel=2 matches bindcraft default_max_parallel.
binder_length defaults to 60 aa; the user may override via params.binder_length.
num_recycles=1 is sufficient for a first-pass design trajectory; increase to 3 if filter-pass rate is low.
boltz2_affinity is configured with msa_backend=none, use_msa=false, diffusion_samples=1, diffusion_samples_affinity=3 for a fast per-candidate affinity estimate.
target_chain defaults to A; override params.target_chain if the binding epitope is on a different chain.
target_sequence must match the FASTA sequence of the target chain used in boltz2_affinity; it can be extracted from the supplied PDB if not already known.
sequence_analysis provides lightweight per-residue biochemical QC (composition, charge, motifs) at zero GPU cost.
rank_designs aggregates all job outputs and returns a deterministic top-2 ranking; post-round submission of the top candidate remains a human decision.
missing_inputs: target_pdb: no PDB file path was supplied in the request; provide the absolute path to the target .pdb file.
target_sequence: the amino-acid sequence of the target chain is required as inline input for boltz2_affinity; extract from the target PDB chain or supply explicitly.
